card.name: Words just before solid or particle terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words and spaces right after a liquid or solution is mentioned, where a next word like solid, particles or particulate matter could follow. Seen in dissolving, reconstitution and visual-inspection instructions.

modes.label: Particles in a solution
modes.description: Linking words such as 'contains' or 'no' before particles or particulate matter in a solution.
modes.example: opalescent, colorless to light yellow solution. Do not use if the solution is cloudy or discolored or<< contains>> particles. Do not use the syringe

modes.label: Dissolving a powder
modes.description: Words like 'all' or 'no' in directions to swirl or shake until material is dissolved.
modes.example: reconstitute by adding 5 mL of Sterile Water for Injection. Swirl gently until<< all>> material is dissolved. Avoid vigorous mixing.

modes.label: Liquid or semi-liquid
modes.description: The word 'or' linking liquid to a semi-liquid or solid form.
